name: Amazon.com
thesis: Three engines anchored by dual margin expansion, monitored top-down through revenue, operating income, and cash conversion (OCF/FCF/capex intensity): (1) AWS revenue reaccelerating off the ~19% trough with operating margin compounding in the high-30s — validated by AWS YoY growth, segment operating margin, RPO outgrowing recognized revenue, and sequential net-new-revenue dollars stepping up rather than flatlining at scale; (2) North-America retail operating margin expanding structurally from regionalization and cost-to-serve leverage, with NA retail revenue ex-ads carrying its own acceleration so the call isn't just ads attach in disguise; (3) advertising as a third leg compounding at a high-incremental-margin clip that drips through to both retail and consolidated margins. The bet breaks if AWS YoY sits below 20% for two consecutive quarters (share loss vs Azure/GCP), AWS segment margin compresses below 32% for two quarters (depreciation lap unrecovered), NA retail ex-ads YoY runs below 8% for two quarters (ads masking core decel), advertising YoY drops below 18% (category saturation), or capex/AWS-revenue keeps rising while AWS growth fails to reaccelerate — the 'spending without payoff' signal that converts long-cycle capex from earned ROI into stranded AI optionality.
key_driver: AWS revenue growth re-acceleration + advertising scale + retail margin

tier_1_kpis.name: AWS revenue growth (YoY)
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: <20% YoY for 2 consecutive Qs — thesis requires reacceleration off ~19% trough; flatlining vs Azure/GCP at ~30s% implies share loss

tier_1_kpis.name: AWS operating margin
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Compresses below 32% for 2 consecutive Qs (depreciation lap from accelerated server lives)

tier_1_kpis.name: AWS Remaining Performance Obligations (RPO)
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: RPO YoY growth decelerates below AWS revenue YoY for 2 consecutive Qs — backlog is the leading indicator; if contracted revenue is growing slower than recognized revenue, the reacceleration call is unsupported

tier_1_kpis.name: AWS net new revenue $ added (QoQ sequential)
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Sequential $ adds decline for 2 consecutive Qs — absolute dollar adds (not just %) must keep stepping up to validate AI-workload mix translating to revenue; flat/down $ adds at scale = saturation

tier_1_kpis.name: North America retail revenue growth ex-ads (YoY)
tier_1_kpis.current: TBV from latest earnings release (NA segment revenue minus advertising allocated to NA)
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: <8% YoY for 2 consecutive Qs — underlying retail must accelerate independent of ads attach; ads tailwind alone is not the thesis

tier_1_kpis.name: North America retail operating margin
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Operating margin contracts QoQ for 2 consecutive Qs OR drops below 5% on TTM basis

tier_1_kpis.name: Advertising services revenue growth (YoY)
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: <18% YoY for 2 consecutive Qs (slowing from current 20s% would imply category saturation)

tier_1_kpis.name: Capex intensity vs AWS growth
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Capex/AWS-revenue rising while AWS growth not re-accelerating (the 'spending without payoff' signal)

tier_2_kpis.name: Prime member growth + ARPU disclosed metrics
Free cash flow ex-capex ('reverse capex' from finance leases)

tier_3_kpis.name: Healthcare (One Medical, Amazon Pharmacy) revenue scale-up

nuance.bear_case: AWS growth stuck in the 18-22% band while capex compounds at 25%+ creates a 2027 margin shock similar to 2018-2019. Retail margin gains stall as regionalization saturates.
nuance.adversarial_take: If AI workloads concentrate at Azure (OpenAI partnership) and GCP (Anthropic, Vertex AI), AWS share losses compound. Bedrock has not produced a clear winner model the way GPT-4/Claude have.
nuance.stress_test: If AWS prints <18% for 2 Qs AND advertising decelerates below 18%, NA retail margin would have to carry the entire incremental story — historically a bumpy line.

thesis_breakers_qualitative: AWS YoY <20% for 2 consecutive Qs (no reacceleration)
NA retail ex-ads YoY <8% for 2 consecutive Qs (ads masking retail decel)
AWS operating margin below 32% for 2 consecutive Qs

break_rules.narrative: Revenue declining YoY for 2 consecutive quarters — outright top-line contraction.
FCF margin below 5% for 2 consecutive Qs — cash conversion broken. (Universal floor; per-ticker rules below are stricter.)
Operating cash flow declining >10% YoY for 2 consecutive Qs.

AWS revenue YoY <20% for 2 consecutive Qs — thesis requires reacceleration off the ~19% trough into the 20s+ (Azure/GCP ~30s%); failure to accelerate implies share loss and breaks the AWS margin-compounding leg.

break_rules.kpi_name: North America Retail Revenue ex-Ads YoY Growth
break_rules.narrative: NA retail revenue ex-advertising YoY <8% for 2 consecutive Qs — high-margin ads attach can mask underlying retail deceleration; the dual-margin thesis requires core retail (ex-ads) to accelerate on its own.

business_model_rules.narrative: AWS revenue YoY < 15% for 2Q — the cloud-growth thesis is the AMZN multiple driver; sustained sub-15 breaks it.
AWS op margin < 28% for 2Q — high-30s is the recent run rate; sub-28 means AI infra capex is no longer absorbing into operating leverage.
NA Retail op margin < 4% for 2Q — retail flywheel margin thesis depends on continued levering past 5%.
Ads revenue YoY < 18% for 2Q — third profit-pool thesis (after AWS and Prime) fails.
